name: Gateway Module
role: Bridges vehicle CAN domains and participates in battery-protection logic with BMS/QCCM.
diagnostic_value: When many modules report missing messages, use GWM/network/voltage context to find the upstream fault rather than replacing every complaining module.
notes: B1412-96 is a documented false GWM log in the stated JLR context.

name: Battery Monitoring System
role: Measures battery current/voltage/state information from the negative battery path for energy management.
diagnostic_value: Charging or replacing the battery without respecting the BMS path can leave state-of-charge logic misleading.
notes: Use designated charging points/earth and reset/recalibrate after applicable battery replacement.

name: Quiescent Current Control Module
role: Cuts selected non-essential infotainment/climate loads when commanded by energy-management logic.
diagnostic_value: Useful in repeated flat-battery/wake-up investigations; one normal current snapshot does not exclude intermittent wakes.
notes: Located at right rear of luggage compartment in retrieved L405 workshop battery documentation.

name: Battery Junction Box
role: Primary high-current power distribution/fusing near battery architecture.
diagnostic_value: A supply failure can take down several downstream systems at once.
notes: Do not assume a fuse-looking-good test proves holder/feed continuity.

name: Battery Junction Box 2
role: Additional power-distribution junction within L405 battery architecture.
diagnostic_value: Useful when tracing common power feeds across multiple affected modules.
notes: Fitment/architecture can vary with battery derivative.

name: Rear Junction Box
role: Rear electrical distribution and fuse architecture.
diagnostic_value: Early 13MY poor fuse-holder continuity can group EAS, rear HVAC, rear seat and rear-wiper complaints.
notes: Inspect loaded continuity/voltage drop, not only fuse element appearance.

name: Central Junction Box
role: Central body-electrical distribution/control node used across L405 architecture.
diagnostic_value: Treat as a network/power node rather than guessing from one downstream symptom.
notes: Exact configuration and software vary by build/market.

name: Power Supply Distribution Box
role: Additional distribution hardware used on some dual/auxiliary-battery architectures.
diagnostic_value: Check derivative before assuming it exists.
notes: Workshop battery documents show it on selected dual/auxiliary-battery systems.

name: Automatic Temperature Control Module
role: Controls automatic HVAC functions.
diagnostic_value: U3003-62 can be an oversensitive low-voltage log on 13MY when there is no matching climate concern.
notes: A real HVAC symptom still requires diagnosis.

name: Power Steering Control Module
role: Electronic power-assisted steering control.
diagnostic_value: B1304-16 can appear as early-L405 low-voltage diagnostic noise when no steering symptom exists.
notes: Actual heavy steering is safety-critical and must not be dismissed.

name: Electronic Park Brake Control Module
role: Controls electronic parking brake operation.
diagnostic_value: U3000-54 is listed in JLR's early-L405 no-cause DTC bulletin, but real EPB symptoms require diagnosis.
notes: Brake service mode is not a substitute for correct brake-service procedure.

name: Anti-lock Brake System Control Module
role: ABS/stability wheel-speed and chassis-control node; vehicle-speed data is shared to other systems.
diagnostic_value: Wheel-speed/network faults can propagate into navigation, suspension, Terrain Response and driver-assistance symptoms.
notes: Preserve full network scan before replacing a sensor/module.

name: Restraints Control Module
role: Controls restraint-system logic and crash signals.
diagnostic_value: Treat RCM/SRS faults as safety-critical; never defeat or bypass.
notes: This Skill gives interpretation only, not SRS disablement procedures.

name: Instrument Cluster
role: Displays warnings/vehicle information and participates in network gateway/data presentation.
diagnostic_value: A warning shown by the cluster may originate in another module; read source-module DTCs before blaming the cluster.
notes: Infotainment/navigation information can also be delivered to the TFT via MOST/LVDS architecture depending on build.

name: Touch Screen / FCDIM / HLDF
role: Front display/interface; early GEN2.1 system also acts as a gateway/master for portions of the MOST infotainment network.
diagnostic_value: Do not replace it for Bluetooth/audio faults until the responsible IAM/AAM/MOST node is proved.
notes: Terminology varies by document: TS, FCDIM, HLDF/high-level display front.

name: Integrated Audio Module
role: Early L405 audio-source/Bluetooth-control node in GEN2.1 architecture.
diagnostic_value: Bluetooth connectivity complaints route here before touchscreen replacement.
notes: Architecture differs on later InControl Touch Pro cars.

name: Audio Amplifier Module
role: Amplifies/processes audio output on Meridian-equipped architectures and participates in MOST.
diagnostic_value: A MOST conflict or amplifier/node fault can remove audio while touchscreen remains functional.
notes: Do not assume no sound means failed speakers or screen.

name: Integrated Control Panel
role: Centre-stack hard/soft control interface for infotainment/climate functions.
diagnostic_value: A dead panel can be downstream of power/network faults rather than a panel failure.
notes: 13MY C44-R2 CAN fault can include an unresponsive A/C/control panel.

name: Navigation Control Module
role: Navigation module on market/equipment configurations that use a separate NCM.
diagnostic_value: Navigation-only faults should be isolated from general touchscreen/MOST problems.
notes: Market architecture varies; Asia/Japan can use separate navigation hardware.

name: Keyless Vehicle Module
role: Manages passive-entry/keyless functions and authorized Smart Key behavior.
diagnostic_value: 13MY programming history matters because JLR documented a software update reducing passive-entry/key range.
notes: No immobilizer bypass/key-programming instructions are provided.

name: Side Object Detection Left
role: Left blind-spot/side-object radar module.
diagnostic_value: U3003-62 can be an oversensitive early-L405 voltage log if there is no matching BSM concern.
notes: Dirty/damaged sensors, bumper alignment and real power/network faults still matter.

name: Side Object Detection Right
role: Right blind-spot/side-object radar module.
diagnostic_value: Interpret with paired SODL and voltage/network context.
notes: U3003-62 appears in JLR's no-cause list for the stated 13MY context.

name: Seat-belt Pretensioner Module A
role: Pretensioner subsystem module named in early-L405 scan data.
diagnostic_value: U0001-81 can be no-cause diagnostic noise in JLR SSM62457 context.
notes: Any live SRS warning remains safety-critical.

name: Seat-belt Pretensioner Module B
role: Second pretensioner subsystem module named in early-L405 scan data.
diagnostic_value: Interpret paired communication codes with voltage/network history before replacement.
notes: Never bypass restraint systems.

name: Deployable Side Step control module
role: Controls optional deployable side steps.
diagnostic_value: JLR documented modules being replaced when the accessory had not been fully enabled/initialized.
notes: Confirm configuration/initialization before replacing ECU.

name: Parking Aid / Proximity Camera control context
role: Camera/parking-aid control architecture varies with equipment; routes surround-camera and parking imagery/sensors.
diagnostic_value: Blue-screen camera faults can be localized by JLR's paired-camera behavior before replacing the wrong camera.
notes: Use exact scan-module naming from the vehicle; do not force this shorthand if tool labels differently.

name: Telematics Control Module
role: Later/option-dependent InControl telematics, cellular/GPS and assistance functions.
diagnostic_value: Do not assume a 2013 car has later telematics hardware/features; identify build/market first.
notes: Included for wider L405 coverage, not as guaranteed MY13 equipment.
